text:
The pedestrian's statement is inadmissible hearsay: it is an out-of-court statement by an unidentified, unavailable declarant offered to prove the man failed to signal, and it does not qualify as a present sense impression because it was made after the accident and describes the event rather than contemporaneously. It also fails as an excited utterance since it expresses an opinion on fault rather than describing the event. Thus the correct choice is "Inadmissible because the bystander is unidentified and absent."
CONFIDENCE: 75
